beneficiary: Nanoda maintainers and users of routine Cargo tests
deliverable: One test-only patch for six native-operation dispatch arms and disabled-extension control, focused/full current test evidence and indexed unsubmitted PR draft.
contract: Closed actual Nat literal operands and configured canonical operation names must dispatch to the matching arithmetic result; disabled extension returns None. This internal implementation contract makes no public export reachability or new Lean authority claim.
reused_boundary: Nat.land is a known regression control; other cases extend internal preventive coverage.
prelaunch_gate: Commit exact source/tree, patch, fixtures/name-cache construction, expected cases, invocation/environment/dependencies, runner identities and reservations before each launch.
scope: No implementation fixes, new serialized exports, proof, mutant or external write.
